submission.justification:
Based on systematic simulation studies across all three candidate materials and multiple plate thicknesses, Absorber-F2 with 4 mm plate thickness delivers the best energy resolution of 3.195% at 100 GeV. This configuration was validated through:

1. Initial screening at 5 mm showing F2's superior performance (3.2% vs 3.9% for F3 and 5.1% for F1)
2. Comprehensive scans from 2-10 mm in 2 mm steps for all materials
3. Fine-tuning around the optimum with 3 mm thickness test (3.287%)
4. Boundary verification confirming 4 mm is the true optimum

The F2 material with 4 mm plates achieves approximately 16% better resolution than the next best option (F3 at 6 mm with 3.813%) and significantly outperforms F1 across all thicknesses tested. The configuration meets all constraints including the 2-10 mm thickness range and allows for hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 at 4 mm thickness achieves 3.195% energy resolution, which is the best among all tested configurations across all three materials and all plate thicknesses from 2-10 mm

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is one of the three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) identified and tested

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns
requirements.evidence: All three candidate materials were pre-screened for this requirement. Absorber-F2 satisfies the hands-on maintenance constraint
The recommended plate thickness of 4 mm falls within the specified range of 2-10 mm
